descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S04 「Decline 登出并再次询问；服务商列表或文件版本变了会再次询问；运维设的链接和授权声明就是服务器给出的」 Decline signs out and asks again; a provider-list or document-version change asks again; the operator's links and attestation are what the server serves

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 On first sign-in, before any AI feature can be used, one agreements screen shows: the AI consent, links to the Terms of Use and the BAA, and two checkboxes (the agreement and the authorization attest …（UAT OAT-01 step 7；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94700 AC 7；TFA-94700 AC 8；TFA-94700 AC 9；TFA-94700 AC 11；UAT 3.3）
  • T5 Sign out ends the session. The physician must sign in again with an email code.（TFA-94700 AC 2）
  • T6 The consent and agreements screen comes back when the AI provider list changes, or when the document version is changed in Convex. The re-acceptance is stored.（TFA-94700 AC 10；TFA-94700 AC 11）
  • U11 The agreement acceptance is saved with the physician, a timestamp, the document version and both checkbox acceptances.（UAT OAT-01 step 10；TFA-94700 AC 10；TFA-94700 AC 11）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Brand-new accounts: one on the agreements screen; one that already accepted, in Nursing Home; one that already accepted, in Hospital; a signed-in API client after an operator agreements:_set

When (a) Tick both boxes, then press Decline, and sign in again. (b) Change the provider list the account accepted, then reload. (c) Change the accepted document version, then reload and accept. (d) Send an acceptance naming a version the server no longer uses. …

Then (a) Decline lands on the sign-in screen, stores nothing, and the next sign-in shows the screen again with both boxes unticked. (b) The screen comes back in Nursing Home, and Continue returns to the Nursing Home list. (c) The screen comes back in Hospital, and the re-acceptance is a second row (old version, new version). …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：consent.spec.ts and api/agreements.spec.ts assertions: U7 (Decline signs out), T5 (sign-in needed again), T6 (asked again on a change; the re-acceptance is stored as a new row), U11 (row history), UAT 3.3. Only the provider-list re-ask runs in Nursing Home here; Decline in Nursing Home is S05 cell (e). Cell (e) checks the query only; …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
